description: The figure contains two side-by-side vertical bar charts illustrating Fleiss’ Kappa values across different ambiguity-related category levels, with one panel varying “Ambiguity Std” and the other varying “Max Ambiguity.” In the left chart, the horizontal axis lists the Ambiguity Std categories (0.0, 0.47, 0.82, 0.94) in left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Fleiss Kappa” on a linear scale spanning roughly 0.0 to just under 1.0 with evenly spaced tick marks (about 0.2 increments); four dark teal bars are shown with value labels above them: Ambiguity Std 0.0 has a bar at approximately 0.88, 0.47 is approximately 0.46, 0.82 is approximately 0.03, and 0.94 is approximately 0.24. In the right chart, the horizontal axis lists Max Ambiguity categories (1, 2, 3) in left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is also labeled “Fleiss Kappa” with the same linear scaling and approximate range; three dark teal bars are shown with value labels: Max Ambiguity 1 is approximately 0.89, 2 is approximately 0.46, and 3 is approximately 0.23. No legend is present, the bars are not stacked or grouped within each category beyond the single series per panel, and there is no visual emphasis beyond the numeric annotations; the category orders appear to follow increasing numeric values rather than an explicit sorting by bar height.
